function: Joint power allocation of access points and phase-shift design of stacked intelligent metasurfaces to maximize downlink sum spectral efficiency (p. 1-2).
system: Cell-free massive MIMO, L=8 APs with 2-4 antennas each, each AP with a stacked intelligent metasurface (M layers, N x N meta-atoms), single-antenna UEs, 28 GHz (p. 2, 4).
method: Multi-agent PPO with noisy values and recurrent policy (NVR-MAPPO); reinforcement learning, centralized training with decentralized execution, each AP-SIM group is an agent (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulated channel: large-scale factor with Rayleigh small-scale fading, channel model of reference [17]; 100 m by 100 m area, random UE positions; no dataset (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Sum SE swept over number of SIM layers and meta-atoms with the same training period per method; no stated test on scenarios unseen in training (p. 5).
baselines: Learned: MAPPO, MADDPG. Non-learned: codebook-based method with random phase shifts and iterative water-filling power allocation [18] (p. 5).
metrics: Sum spectral efficiency; average reward versus training episode (convergence speed) (p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "we use the channel model from [17]"; p. 2: "Rayleigh fading vector composed of the small-scale fading coefficients". Custom Rayleigh simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 5: "During the same training period, MARL methods enhance performance by at least 50%". Sweeps over layers and meta-atoms are compared at equal training; no model is tested on a configuration unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 5: "MARL methods enhance performance by at least 50% compared to traditional codebook-based methods"; p. 5: "performance improvement of at least 15% over MADDPG". Non-learned codebook method and learned MADDPG, both on sum SE.
q4_support: p. 5: "reduce computational time, making it well-suited for large networks". Qualitative only; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameters or runtime is reported (Fig. 3 shows training convergence only).
q5_support: p. 4: "randomly positioned single-antenna UEs". Simulated channels only; no link to code or data, and no public dataset or measured data.
notes: PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint (arXiv:2502.19675v1), not verified against the DOI title. Area 3: the learned MARL policy sets SIM phase shifts and AP power. MAPPO is an ablation of NVR-MAPPO, so MADDPG is the earlier learned baseline for q3.
